ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface (pixel values <50) with discrete, high-intensity white clusters (pixel values >200) providing a high local contrast ratio within a low-intensity global field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; speckled with stochastic, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters ranging from 2 to 15 pixels in diameter distributed across the entire visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle transition between the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-variations (serrations) along the continuous boundary; right lobe exhibits more pronounced pixel-depth variations (peaks) compared to the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the medial notch, curving into a downward-sloping taper toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small, circular white pixel regions (rosettes) concentrated primarily on the central and distal areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of high-intensity white spots across the dark ventral surface, consistent with surface-level pigmentation disruption or focal scarring.
